record.notes: Documented so the subsequent evaluation does not chase it. The pattern is worth noting because it recurred twice among evaluated offerings: an Indonesian free-VPS hobby project with a real spec sheet that has since lapsed. The honest evidence here is contradictory, since automated retrieval served cached page text while the live route went to a for-sale page, so the death is inferred from the parking redirect plus the TLS name mismatch rather than from a stated closure.
